india.one_line: CERT-In released AI security auditing guidelines, Sarvam AI appointed a new president, and IT firms focused on enterprise AI adoption.

themes.title: CERT-In issues AI security auditing guidelines
themes.text: CERT-In released security auditing guidelines for autonomous AI systems, mandating checks for tool use, privilege abuse, and emergency stops across four risk tiers.

stories.headline: CERT-In issues AI security auditing guidelines for autonomous systems

themes.title: Sarvam AI appoints Sashikumar Sreedharan
themes.text: Indian AI startup Sarvam AI appointed former Google Cloud India Managing Director Sashikumar Sreedharan as its new President and Chief Business Officer.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI appoints ex-Google Cloud India MD Sashikumar Sreedharan as President and CBO

themes.title: IT firms and GCCs drive enterprise AI
themes.text: Indian IT firms, Global Capability Centres, and enterprises are forming partnerships and focusing on monetization and customer service AI adoption.
